test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Articles of the constitution refers to the Union Budget as the Annual Financial Statement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 112.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **As indicated via Article 112 of the Indian charter, the Union price range is 12 months.**
 
• **Article 112 of the Constitution** requires the public authority to present to Parliament an assertion of assessed receipts and use in regard to each and every monetary year.</
